has received a $112.4M contract modification to upgrade and sustain Saudi Arabia’s F-15 Advanced Aircrew Training Device Phase II program.
The modification raises the contract’s total value to $256.7M, from the previous $144.3M.
Work will be carried out at three Saudi air bases: King Faisal, King Khalid, and King Abdulaziz Air Bases.
The program is expected to be completed by September 30, 2031, under the U.S. Air Force contract.
The contract is part of a Foreign Military Sales program to Saudi Arabia, with the full $112.4M funded through foreign military funds.

title: Boeing wins $112.4M Saudi F-15 training upgrade contract
